min_interval.title: Shortest update interval, minutes
min_interval.description: A subscription is not refreshed more often than this. Going to the seller's panel more often than it changes hurts the one who hands the subscription out.

max_interval.title: Longest update interval, minutes
max_interval.description: A longer interval is refused: an update nobody waits for.

quota_interval.title: Traffic quota check, minutes
quota_interval.description: How often to ask the panel for the traffic left, without refreshing the nodes. 0 - only on request.
